blocks.task_summary: Evaluate two definite integrals using properties of odd functions and given integral from 0 to 4.
method_path: Given integral of f(|x|) from 0 to 4 is 1.6.
Since f is odd, f(-x) = -f(x), and integral_-4^0 f(x) dx = -integral_0^4 f(x) dx.
From graph, integral_0^4 f(x) dx = integral_0^4 f(|x|) dx = 1.6.
For (c)(ii), split integral: f(|x|) is even, so integral_-4^4 f(|x|) dx = 2 * 1.6 = 3.2.
Integral_-4^4 f(x) dx = 0 because f is odd and interval symmetric.
